dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,10)>Yippee! Nice to meet you!
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>This plot of tall grass is kinda small, but I like it!
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,5)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>I love leaves and grass and stuff. And living by lotsa
green things!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,10)>Prazer em conhecê-lo!
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Este terreno de relva alta é pequeno, mas eu gosto!
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,5)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Adoro folhas, relva e outras coisas.
Coisas verdes!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Heya, do you happen to know what area gets the most sun
’round here?
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,13)>I love to sunbathe every day, but I don’t really know this
place too well.
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,802)>Oh dang! Sorry bud—this is our first time meeting, isn’t it?
My bad, I just went off babbling. <$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)>Let’s be buddies
from now on!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Ei, por acaso sabe qual é a área que mais recebe sol?
Por aqui?
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,13)>Eu amo tomar sol todos os dias, mas eu realmente não sei isso
É um lugar muito bom.
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,802)>Oh dang! Desculpe amigo - esta é a nossa primeira reunião, não é?
Foi mal, eu só fui tagarelando. <$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)>Sejamos amigos
De agora em diante!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,14)>Why, hello there! What a pleasure to meet you! Let me
guess—you were drawn in by the scent of my flower!
...<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,3)>Oh dear. You weren’t? <$emotion(1,1)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,802)>Whoops! There I go jumping to
conclusions again!
<$voicel(1,7)>But still, wouldn’t you agree that this lovely, sweet scent
suits me to a T?
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,9)>If you ever want to find me, just follow your nose!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,14)>Olá, que prazer conhecê-lo!
Adivinhem, vocês foram atraídos pelo cheiro da minha flor!
...<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,3)>Oh, querida. Você não estava? <$emotion(1,1)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,802)>Lá vou eu a saltar
Mais uma vez, conclusões!
<$voicel(1,7)>Mas ainda assim, você não concorda que este adorável, doce perfume
Fica-me bem com um T?
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,9)>Se alguma vez me quiseres encontrar, segue o teu nariz!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,8)><$facial(1,13)><$comeff(1,5)>Uh-oh! <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)>Be careful around my tail—<$motion(1,803)>if you bump into it,
you could get a real nasty burn!
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,3)>My friend stepped on my tail once and got SUPER mad
’cause it was so hot...
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$comeff(1,4)>Even though I’M the one whose tail got trampled! It hurt so
bad I was spitting fire—literally!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,8)><$facial(1,13)><$comeff(1,5)>Uh-oh! <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)>Tem cuidado com a minha cauda.<$motion(1,803)>Se você esbarrar nele,
pode ter uma queimadura muito feia!
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,3)>O meu amigo pisou no meu rabo uma vez e ficou super zangado.
Porque estava tão quente...
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$comeff(1,4)>Mesmo que eu sou aquele cuja cauda foi pisada! Doeu tanto
Foi mau eu ter cuspido fogo — literalmente!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,3)>Oh? Did our eyes just meet? All right,<$motion(1,802)> let’s battle!
...<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,6)>Huh? Wait a sec. <$motion(1,805)>You LOOK like a human, but...<$voicel(1,10)>you’re
actually a Pokémon!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)>Guess I’m not the only one who can do a pretty slick
human impression.
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)>But anyway, nice to meet another talented trickster!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,3)>Oh, sim? Os nossos olhos acabaram de se conhecer?<$motion(1,802)> Vamos batalhar!
...<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,6)>Huh? Espera um segundo. <$motion(1,805)>Pareces um humano, mas...<$voicel(1,10)>você é
Na verdade, um Pokémon!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)>Acho que eu não sou o único que pode fazer um slick bonito
impressão humana.
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)>Mas de qualquer forma, é bom conhecer outro talentoso trapaceiro!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,1)>Hey, heyyy! You live around here? You wouldn’t happen to
know any strong local Pokémon, would ya?
<$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,807)>Strong Pokémon all have a special bond—we just “get”
each other, y’know?
<$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)>So, I was thinkin’ that if I could find someone as strong as
me, maybe we could become buds!
<$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)>No offense, but you don’t look all that strong to me!<$lookat(0,1,1)><$motion(0,748)>
<$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,5)>W-Water Gun?! Maybe I spoke too soon...
<$voicel(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)>All right! You and me are friends now! Catch ya later!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,1)>Hey, heyyy! Você mora por aqui? Você não iria acontecer com
Conheces algum Pokémon local forte, não conheces?
<$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,807)>Forte Pokémon todos têm uma ligação especial – nós apenas “obtemos”
Um ao outro, sabe?
<$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)>Então, eu estava pensando’ que se eu pudesse encontrar alguém tão forte como
Eu, talvez possamos tornar-nos amigos!
<$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)>Sem ofensa, mas você não parece tão forte para mim!<$lookat(0,1,1)><$motion(0,748)>
<$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,5)>Talvez eu tenha falado cedo demais...
<$voicel(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)>Está bem, tu e eu somos amigos agora!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motionoff(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh wow, nice to meet you! Welcome to my place!
<$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,10)>Well, it’s not my place yet. <$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,5)><$motionoff(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>I was gonna move in today!
<$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,5)>It’s a nice spot, though, right? Once I hide in my shell
here, <$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,8)>I’ll be totally safe! <$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motionoff(1,816)><$voicel(1,7)>I bet I can even practice my
Water Gun!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motionoff(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Bem-vindos à minha casa!
<$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,10)>Bem, ainda não é o meu lugar. <$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,5)><$motionoff(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Eu ia mudar-me hoje!
<$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,5)>É um bom lugar, no entanto, certo? Uma vez que eu me escondo na minha concha
Aqui, <$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,8)>Eu estarei totalmente seguro! <$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motionoff(1,816)><$voicel(1,7)>Aposto que posso até praticar o meu
Arma de Água!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,1)>Yo! Nice to meet ya! You can catch me ’round
here anytime!
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,805)>What’s that? You’re <$comeff(1,6)>working hard to make it easier on the
Pokémon living in the area?
Yooo... <$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,5)>That’s amazing! Like totally awesome!
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,21)>Let me know if there’s anything I can help with! <$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,806)>Oh man,
we’re gonna be best buds for, like, 10,000 years!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,1)>Prazer em conhecê-lo! Você pode me pegar
Aqui a qualquer hora!
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,805)>O que é isso? Você é <$comeff(1,6)>trabalhando duro para tornar mais fácil na
O Pokémon vive na área?
Yooo... <$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,5)>Isso é incrível! Como totalmente incrível!
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,21)>Avise-me se houver alguma coisa em que eu possa ajudar! <$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,806)>Oh, meu,
vamos ser melhores amigos para, tipo, 10.000 anos!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,12)>Well, howdy there! You got some hustle in yer bustle,
don’t ya?!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)>What’s got ya runnin’ all over the place?
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,14)>...Waterin’ the tall grass? And the flowers too? To make
this place more pleasant for all the Pokémon here?
<$facial(1,5)><$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,10)>What a mighty fine thing to do! Truly commendable!
<$facial(1,1)>I’d love to help out myself...
<$facial(1,10)><$voicel(1,2)><$motion(1,807)><$comeff(1,18)>But if I tried waterin’ all the plants, I’m like to wash away
all the hard work you’ve done so far...<$facial(1,1)>
<$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,1)>I tell you what, if there’s anythin’ ELSE I can help with, jus’
lemme know! I’ll be cheerin’ ya on in the meantime!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,12)>Bem, olá!
não é verdade?!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)>O que tem você correndo’ em todo o lugar?
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,14)>... Água’ a grama alta? E as flores também? Para fazer
Este lugar é mais agradável para todos os Pokémon aqui?
<$facial(1,5)><$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,10)>Que coisa excelente de se fazer! Verdadeiramente louvável!
<$facial(1,1)>Eu adoraria ajudar a mim mesmo...
<$facial(1,10)><$voicel(1,2)><$motion(1,807)><$comeff(1,18)>Mas se eu tentei molhar’ todas as plantas, eu sou como para lavar
todo o trabalho duro que você tem feito até agora...<$facial(1,1)>
<$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,1)>Digo-te uma coisa, se houver alguma coisa em que eu possa ajudar, só
Deixe-me saber! Eu vou estar torcendo’ em você enquanto isso!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,5)><$motionoff(1,807)><$facial(1,13)><$voicel(1,10)>Eep! A human! Oooh, are you trying to catch me?!
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)>...<$voicel(1,8)>Huh? <$comeff(1,6)><$motionoff(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motionoff(1,801)><$comeff(1,21)>Now that I get a closer look at you, you’re not
a human at all—you’re a Pokémon!
<$comeff(1,13)><$voicel(1,7)><$pkcry;1(1,2)>! I can’t believe I met a Pokémon who can
transform into a human! <$facial(1,5)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,9)>That’s so super AWESOME!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,5)><$motionoff(1,807)><$facial(1,13)><$voicel(1,10)>Eep! Um humano! Oooh, você está tentando me pegar?!
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)>...<$voicel(1,8)>Huh? <$comeff(1,6)><$motionoff(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motionoff(1,801)><$comeff(1,21)>Agora que eu olho mais de perto para você, você não é
um humano em tudo – você é um Pokémon!
<$comeff(1,13)><$voicel(1,7)><$pkcry;1(1,2)>Não acredito que conheci um Pokémon que pode
transformar-se em um humano! <$facial(1,5)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,9)>Isso é tão super incrível!

dialogues.en:
<$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,5)>Whoa! Who’re you? I found this place first, pal.<$motion(0,824)><$comeff(0,1)><$motion(0,652)>
<$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,6)>Say what? YOU made this pretty little field?<$voicel(1,6)> All so that
Pokémon can live here, eh?
<$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,21)>Dang, that’s seriously awesome! Mad respect.
<$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)>I think I’ll live here now! Thanks a million—I owe ya!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,5)>Quem é você? Eu encontrei este lugar primeiro, amigo.<$motion(0,824)><$comeff(0,1)><$motion(0,652)>
<$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,6)>Fizeste este lindo campozinho?<$voicel(1,6)> Tudo para que
O Pokémon pode viver aqui, não?
<$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,21)>Caramba, isso é realmente incrível! Respeito louco.
<$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)>Eu acho que vou viver aqui agora! Obrigado um milhão – eu te devo!

dialogues.en:
<$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,3)>Whew, I’m beat... Maybe I’ll have a little rest here for
a bit.<$lookat(1,1,0)>
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>Oh, dear—you didn’t hear me just now, did you?
How embarrassing!
<$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,10)>I was flying around for the first time in a while and it really
took it out of me... Must be because I slept for so long.
<$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,21)>Even so, being back in the sky feels wonderful!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,3)>Whew, eu estou cansado... Talvez eu vou ter um pouco de descanso aqui para
Um pouco.<$lookat(1,1,0)>
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>Oh, querida - você não me ouviu agora, não é?
Que vergonha!
<$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,10)>Eu estava a voar pela primeira vez em algum tempo e realmente
Tirei-o de mim... deve ser porque dormi tanto tempo.
<$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,21)>Mesmo assim, voltar ao céu é maravilhoso!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,10)><$pkcry;0(1,2)>!!!
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,801)>Hehe! Gotcha! Pretty scary, right?
<$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,3)>Huh... Your expression didn’t change. Weren’t you scared?
Even a tiny bit?
<$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>That’s so weird... I thought I was being super sneaky.
<$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,21)><$voicel(1,8)>Wow, you sure have nerves of steel!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,10)><$pkcry;0(1,2)>!!!
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,801)>Foi assustador, não foi?
<$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,3)>Huh... Sua expressão não mudou. Você não estava com medo?
Nem um bocadinho?
<$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Isso é tão estranho... Eu pensei que eu estava sendo super sorrateira.
<$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,21)><$voicel(1,8)>tem mesmo nervos de aço!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,816)><$voicel(1,9)>Ssshaaa! Nice to meetcha!<$motion(0,215)>
Wait...<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,802)> Aren’t you scared?
<$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,806)>Usually whenever I say hi to someone, they take one look
at this pattern on my belly and take off running.
<$comeff(1,7)><$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,807)>I’m not gonna lie, it kinda hurts my feelings, y’know?
<$comeff(1,9)><$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,803)>But you seem fine around me, so we should be pals!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,816)><$voicel(1,9)>Prazer em conhecê-la!<$motion(0,215)>
Espera...<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,802)> Não está com medo?
<$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,806)>Normalmente, sempre que digo olá a alguém, eles dão uma olhada.
com este padrão na minha barriga e decolar.
<$comeff(1,7)><$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,807)>Eu não vou mentir, isso meio que me magoa, sabe?
<$comeff(1,9)><$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,803)>Mas pareces bem perto de mim, por isso devíamos ser amigos!

dialogues.en:
<$motion(1,805)>... ... ...
<$facial(1,3)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,1)>OH! Hi! Nice to meet you!
<$facial(1,5)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,21)>This is my first time in the area, but it looks like an
awesome place to live!
<$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)>OK, I’ve got a great idea! Let’s tap our tails together so
we’ll always remember the moment we became friends!
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,9)>... ... ...<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,9)>Hm?
<$facial(1,13)><$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)>OH! <$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,801)>I just noticed you don’t actually HAVE a tail. Whoops.
<$voicel(1,6)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,13)><$motion(1,801)>But you’re my friend from now on—tail or no tail!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$motion(1,805)>... ... ...
<$facial(1,3)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,1)>Prazer em conhecê-lo!
<$facial(1,5)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,21)>Esta é a minha primeira vez na área, mas parece um
lugar incrível para viver!
<$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)>OK, eu tenho uma ótima idéia! Vamos bater nossas caudas juntos assim
sempre nos lembraremos do momento em que nos tornamos amigos!
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,9)>... ... ...<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,9)>Hm?
<$facial(1,13)><$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)>Oh! <$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,801)>Eu só notei que você não tem realmente uma cauda.
<$voicel(1,6)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,13)><$motion(1,801)>Mas você é meu amigo a partir de agora - cauda ou sem cauda!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,816)>Zzzp... Zzzhppp... <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,21)>Oh, that’s coming along nicely!
<$lookat(1,1,0)><$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,802)>Goodness gracious! You didn’t see that just now, did you?
How frightfully embarrassing!
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)>I was just charging up electricity in my tail, you see—to
help shake off this groggy feeling! I’ve been so sleepy...
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,814)><$comeff(1,13)>And if I don’t have electricity, I simply can’t muster up any
energy! Zzzhhhuuu...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,816)>Zzzp... Zzzhppp... <$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,21)>Oh, isso está indo muito bem!
<$lookat(1,1,0)><$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,802)>Santo Deus! Você não viu isso agora, viu?
Que embaraçoso!
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)>Eu estava apenas carregando eletricidade na minha cauda, você vê - para
ajudar a sacudir fora desta sensação groggy! Eu tenho sido tão sonolento...
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,814)><$comeff(1,13)>E se eu não tenho eletricidade, simplesmente não posso reunir qualquer
energia!

dialogues.en:

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,13)><$motion(1,802)>You know, the dirt around here is so soft and moist...
It’s just perfect!
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,803)>I was thinking I might actually start living here. I hope we
can be friends!<$motion(0,181)>
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,817)>POP *<$comeff(0,5)><$motion(0,182)>
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,1)>Olá! Espero não ter assustado você.
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)>E talvez seja uma altura estranha para dizer isto, mas...
Vou-me encontrar com você!
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,13)><$motion(1,802)>sabe, a terra por aqui é tão macia e húmida...
É simplesmente perfeito!
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,803)>Estava a pensar em começar a viver aqui.
Podem ser amigos!<$motion(0,181)>

<$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,817)><$comeff(1,5)>Oof! <$comeff(0,5)><$motion(0,82)><$comeff(1,5)>Ow, ow, ow...
<$voicel(1,8)>Sorry ’bout that! Probably didn’t feel too great for you
either, huh?
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,19)>Y’know, I recently bumped my head against a rock poppin’
myself outta the ground! <$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,803)>Glad I hit a Pokémon this time,
at least!
<$voicel(1,5)>But hey, us meetin’ like this... Sorta feels like fate, don’t
ya think?
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,10)>Guess we’ll just have to be buds from now on!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,817)><$comeff(1,5)>Oof! <$comeff(0,5)><$motion(0,82)><$comeff(1,5)>Ow, ow, ow...
<$voicel(1,8)>Desculpe por isso! Provavelmente não se sentiu muito bem para você
Nem um pouco, huh?
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,19)>Você sabe, eu recentemente bateu minha cabeça contra um rock poppin’
Eu mesmo, fora do chão! <$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,803)>Ainda bem que bati num Pokémon desta vez.
Pelo menos!
<$voicel(1,5)>Mas ei, nós nos encontrando’ como este... Meio que parece destino, não
Achas?
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,10)>Acho que vamos ter que ser buds de agora em diante!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,13)>Meow?
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,13)>Meow me—ack, where’d it go?! <$comeff(1,4)>You gotta be kitten me!
<$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,29)>Hey, you with the face! Have you seen my treasure?!
<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,46)>I coulda sworn it rolled this way...
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,9)>Aw, fine. Guess I’ve gotta look for a NEW treasure now.
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,49)>If you’re lucky, maybe I’ll let you help me out!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,13)>Miau?
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,13)>Miau-me – saco, para onde foi?! <$comeff(1,4)>tem de ser o meu gatinho!
<$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,29)>Viste o meu tesouro?
<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,46)>Eu podia jurar que era assim...
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,805)><$facial(1,9)>Acho que agora tenho de procurar um novo tesouro.
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,49)>Se você tiver sorte, talvez eu deixe você me ajudar!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,1)>Who do we have here? I’ve not seen your face before.
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,803)>In any case, it’s a pleasure to meet you. Allow me to
extend my warmest greetings.<$motion(1,807)>
<$voicel(1,9)>Well? How did you like my elegant bow?<$motion(0,215)>
<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)>Goodness, what a graceful little greeting! Color
me impressed.
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,21)>I must say, I’m slightly saddened that your bow was more
elegant than mine...<$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,13)> But I won’t hold it against you.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,1)>Quem temos aqui? Eu nunca vi seu rosto antes.
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,803)>Em qualquer caso, é um prazer conhecê-lo.
Estendam as minhas calorosas saudações.<$motion(1,807)>
<$voicel(1,9)>Gostaste do meu elegante arco?<$motion(0,215)>
<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)>Meu Deus, que pequena saudação graciosa!
Estou impressionado.
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,21)>Devo dizer, Estou ligeiramente triste que seu arco foi mais
Elegante que o meu...<$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,13)> Mas eu não vou culpá-lo contra você.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,816)><$voicel(1,1)>Hmmm... What did I do yesterday? I can’t remember.
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)>Oh, it’s you.<$motion(1,802)> Ummm... We’re friends...right?
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Oops! Never mind. Uh... It’s nice to meet you, then!<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,13)> Let’s
be friends from now on!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,816)><$voicel(1,1)>Hmmm... O quê? Eu fiz ontem? Não me lembro.
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)>Oh, Oh, É você.<$motion(1,802)> Ummm... Somos amigos... certo?
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Esquece. Uh... É um prazer conhecê-lo, então!<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,13)> Vamos
Sejam amigos a partir de agora!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)><$facial(1,4)>Whoo! This place is great! Nice and quiet—and the water
is wicked gorgeous!
<$voicel(1,8)>Say, bud! Wanna join me for a little swimming?
<$motion(1,824)><$comeff(1,6)>...What?! You CAN’T swim?
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>With those slick hands and feet of yours, I figured you’d
be a great swimmer! Huh...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)><$facial(1,4)>Este lugar é fantástico, agradável e silencioso, e a água
É muito bonito!
<$voicel(1,8)>Amigo, quer ir nadar comigo?
<$motion(1,824)><$comeff(1,6)>O quê?! Você não sabe nadar?
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>Com essas mãos e pés lisos de seus, eu pensei que você
ser um grande nadador! Huh...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,816)><$voicel(1,9)>Ruff! Ruff ruff!<$motion(0,82)><$comeff(0,5)>
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,1)>Oh, whoops, sorry. Did I scare you?
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,817)><$voicel(1,5)>I thought you’d come to steal my home...
<$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,5)>But now that I look at you, I can tell you’re not that kind
of Pokémon. <$voicel(1,8)>My mistake!
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,13)>I hope you’ll be my friend!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,816)><$voicel(1,9)>Ruff, Ruff!<$motion(0,82)><$comeff(0,5)>
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,1)>Desculpa, assustei-te?
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,817)><$voicel(1,5)>Pensei que virias roubar-me a casa...
<$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,5)>Mas agora que eu olho para você, posso dizer que você não é desse tipo
de Pokémon. <$voicel(1,8)>Erro meu!
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,13)>Espero que você seja meu amigo!

dialogues.en:
<$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,23)><$voicel(1,3)>*yawn* My body’s gotten all stiff...
<$motion(1,817)><$facial(1,3)><$comeff(1,22)><$voicel(1,9)><$textsize(2)>GRAAAWR!
<$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,1)><$voicel(1,8)>Oh! Did I scare you? Sorry ’bout that, bud.
<$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)><$voicel(1,5)>I overslept a bit, so I figured I’d go for a little run to wake
myself up.
<$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,9)><$voicel(1,10)>Just tryin’ to get in the right headspace first with a quick
roar, y’know?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,23)><$voicel(1,3)>Meu corpo ficou todo duro...
<$motion(1,817)><$facial(1,3)><$comeff(1,22)><$voicel(1,9)><$textsize(2)>Graawr!
<$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,1)><$voicel(1,8)>Desculpa lá isso, amigo.
<$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)><$voicel(1,5)>Dormi um pouco demais, então pensei em dar uma corridinha para acordar.
Eu mesmo me levanto.
<$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,9)><$voicel(1,10)>Apenas tentando entrar no headspace certo primeiro com um rápido
rugido, sabe?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,815)><$comeff(1,12)>Whoops! ’Scuse me!<$comeff(0,12)><$motion(0,182)>
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,17)>I’m really sorry... I only just got my legs, so I’m not used to
walking yet...
<$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,1)>Wait... You don’t even have legs!
<$voicel(1,10)><$motion(0,181)><$motion(1,816)><$comeff(1,5)>Wha—and now you do! Did they just grow?!<$motion(0,250)> <$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,10)>And you’re
walking around, just like that!
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,14)>Your legs just came in, and you’re already walking around
like a pro...<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,10)> That’s so cool!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,815)><$comeff(1,12)>Com licença!<$comeff(0,12)><$motion(0,182)>
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,17)>Eu sinto muito... Eu só tenho minhas pernas, então eu não estou acostumado
Ainda a andar...
<$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,1)>Espere... Você nem tem pernas!
<$voicel(1,10)><$motion(0,181)><$motion(1,816)><$comeff(1,5)>E agora você faz! Eles simplesmente crescem?!!<$motion(0,250)> <$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,10)>E você é
Andar por aí, assim mesmo!
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,14)>Suas pernas acabaram de chegar, e você já está andando por aí
Como um profissional...<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,10)> Isso é tão legal!

dialogues.en:
<$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,21)>Whoooaaa! The water here’s so prettyyy.
<$lookat(1,1,0)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,5)>Oh! Um, nice to meet you. Did you come here to swim,
too?
<$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,10)>The water might get a little slimy after I swim around in
it, so...<$motion(1,817)><$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,13)>you can go first! ♪
dialogues.pt_br:
<$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,21)>Whoooaa! A água aqui é tão bonita.
<$lookat(1,1,0)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,5)>Prazer em conhecer-te.
Também?
<$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,10)>A água pode ficar um pouco pegajosa depois de eu nadar em volta
Então...<$motion(1,817)><$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,13)>pode ir primeiro!

dialogues.en:
<$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,1)><$voicel(1,9)>Wraaaa!
<$motion(1,816)><$comeff(1,10)><$voicel(1,10)>Well? Whaddya think of these fierce fists of mine? I can
split boulders in two with just one punch!<$motion(0,518)><$motion(0,519)>
<$motion(1,801)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,11)>Whoa! <$voicel(1,8)>Dang, looks like you’re pretty fierce too.
<$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,23)><$voicel(1,3)>I don’t want us to fight, pal, but if that ever happened...
Hypothetically speaking, y’know?
<$voicel(1,5)>On the off chance that we ever have to fight each other,
<$motion(1,814)><$comeff(1,10)><$voicel(1,10)>promise me we’ll settle it with a swimming contest!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,1)><$voicel(1,9)>Wraaaa!
<$motion(1,816)><$comeff(1,10)><$voicel(1,10)>O que achas destes meus punhos ferozes?
Dividir pedras em dois com apenas um soco!<$motion(0,518)><$motion(0,519)>
<$motion(1,801)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,11)>Whoa! <$voicel(1,8)>Dang, parece que você é muito feroz também.
<$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,23)><$voicel(1,3)>Eu não quero que a gente brigue, amigo, mas se isso acontecer...
Hipoteticamente falando, sabe?
<$voicel(1,5)>Na hipótese de termos de lutar uns contra os outros,
<$motion(1,814)><$comeff(1,10)><$voicel(1,10)>Prometa-me que vamos resolver isso com um concurso de natação!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,15)>... ... ...
<$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,9)><$voicel(1,3)>Ahh, what a great nap. ♪
<$comeff(1,6)><$voicel(1,6)>Um... Who are you?
<$voicel(1,7)>Well, you don’t SEEM like a meanie or anything.
<$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,16)><$voicel(1,5)>OK, I’m thinking it’s nap time for just a biiit longer...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,15)>... ... ...
<$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,9)><$voicel(1,3)>Que grande sesta.
<$comeff(1,6)><$voicel(1,6)>Quem é você?
<$voicel(1,7)>Bem, você não parece um mau ou algo assim.
<$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,16)><$voicel(1,5)>OK, eu estou pensando que é hora de dormir apenas um pouco mais...

dialogues.en:
<$facial(1,2)><$comeff(1,14)>... ... ...
<$voicel(1,5)>Sorry, I’m meditating right now. Think you could give me
some space?
<$comeff(1,14)>... ... ...
<$facial(1,3)><$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,12)>Oh, actually...
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,1)>I’m pretty new to this area and still getting my bearings, so
it’d mean a lot if we could be friends. Thanks.
<$facial(1,2)><$comeff(1,14)>... ... ...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$facial(1,2)><$comeff(1,14)>... ... ...
<$voicel(1,5)>Desculpe, estou meditando agora. Acho que você poderia me dar
Algum espaço?
<$comeff(1,14)>... ... ...
<$facial(1,3)><$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,12)>Na verdade...
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,1)>Eu sou muito novo para esta área e ainda estou me orientando, então
seria muito importante se pudéssemos ser amigos. Obrigado.
<$facial(1,2)><$comeff(1,14)>... ... ...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,8)>Hm? If I’m not mistaken, you’re...<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,6)>a <$cdef(27)>Ditto, right?
<$comeff(1,13)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,4)>Well, isn’t this a sight to behold! In all my years, I’ve
never seen a Ditto transformed into a human.
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)><$facial(1,1)>Speaking of humans, I don’t see any around here—<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,6)>so how
were you able to transform into one?
<$comeff(1,13)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,9)><$facial(1,4)>Oh, no need to answer that. Just musing to myself.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,8)>Hm? Se eu não estou enganado, você é...<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,6)>a <$cdef(27)>DittoCerto?
<$comeff(1,13)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,4)>Bem, não é uma visão para contemplar! Em todos os meus anos, eu tenho
Nunca vi um Ditto transformado em humano.
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)><$facial(1,1)>Falando em humanos, não vejo nenhum por aqui...<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,6)>Então, como
Você foi capaz de se transformar em um?
<$comeff(1,13)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,9)><$facial(1,4)>Não precisas de responder a isso, só a pensar em mim.

dialogues.en:
<$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,6)><$voicel(1,5)>Hey, quick question: you seen any boulders around here?
<$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,814)><$comeff(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)>My muscles lost their oomph while I was asleep, <$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,8)>so I wanna
build ’em back up with some training!
<$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,10)><$voicel(1,9)>You gotta lift heavy weights to be a heavyweight!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,6)><$voicel(1,5)>Pergunta rápida: viste algumas pedras por aqui?
<$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,814)><$comeff(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)>Os meus músculos perderam a força enquanto eu dormia. <$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,8)>Por isso, eu quero
construa - os de volta com algum treinamento!
<$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,10)><$voicel(1,9)>tem de levantar pesos pesados para seres um peso pesado!

dialogues.en:
<$motion(1,814)><$comeff(1,13)><$voicel(1,10)>HYAH!
<$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,10)><$voicel(1,9)>Oh, hey! You watchin’ me train? Whaddaya think? My
punches pack a lotta power, huh?
<$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,5)><$voicel(1,5)>...Nothing? Not even a raised eyebrow? Dang.<$voicel(1,8)> You’re
something else, pal!
<$motion(1,815)><$voicel(1,9)>HRRRAAAH! How’s THAT?
<$voicel(1,1)><$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,11)>Seriously? Is your face stuck? Have you only got one
expression? Yeesh.
<$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,1)><$voicel(1,3)>Well, whatever. That was barely even half of my full
power anyway!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$motion(1,814)><$comeff(1,13)><$voicel(1,10)>HYAH!
<$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,10)><$voicel(1,9)>Oh, hey! Você está me assistindo treinar? O que você acha?
Os socos têm muita energia, não é?
<$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,5)><$voicel(1,5)>Nem uma sobrancelha levantada?<$voicel(1,8)> Você é
Outra coisa, amigo!
<$motion(1,815)><$voicel(1,9)>Que tal?
<$voicel(1,1)><$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,11)>A sério, tem a cara presa?
Expressão?
<$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,1)><$voicel(1,3)>Bem, tanto faz.
Poderes, de qualquer maneira!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,814)><$voicel(1,10)>Triceps! Biceps!
<$comeff(1,22)><$motion(1,816)><$voicel(1,8)>Pecs! Delts!
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,817)><$voicel(1,10)>And don’t forget my lats and my traps!
<$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)><$facial(1,4)>Oh yeahhh. My muscles are lookin’ shredded today...<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$lookat(1,1,0)>
<$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,13)>Hey! Whoa! Have you been there this whole time?
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,5)><$facial(1,1)>Wait, are you obsessed with muscles too?!
<$comeff(1,13)><$motion(1,825)><$voicel(1,9)><$facial(1,1)>Heck yeah, bud! Let’s train together! Muscles are life!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,814)><$voicel(1,10)>Tríceps!
<$comeff(1,22)><$motion(1,816)><$voicel(1,8)>Pecs!
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,817)><$voicel(1,10)>E não se esqueça dos meus lats e das minhas armadilhas!
<$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)><$facial(1,4)>Oh yeahhh. Meus músculos estão olhando’ rasgado hoje...<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$lookat(1,1,0)>
<$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,13)>Estiveste lá este tempo todo?
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,5)><$facial(1,1)>Espera, também está obcecado com músculos?!
<$comeff(1,13)><$motion(1,825)><$voicel(1,9)><$facial(1,1)>Diabos sim, amigo! Vamos treinar juntos! Músculos são vida!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,3)>I can’t wait until I’m all grown up.
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,4)>I bet I’ll grow into a pretty flower.
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,8)><$facial(1,1)>What do you think?<$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,10)> Will I bloom into a beautiful flower?
<$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)><$facial(1,4)>Hee hee... Yeah, I just know I will!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,3)>Mal posso esperar até que eu esteja toda crescida.
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)><$facial(1,4)>Eu aposto que vou crescer em uma flor bonita.
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,8)><$facial(1,1)>O que achas?<$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,10)> Vou florescer em uma flor bonita?
<$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)><$facial(1,4)>Sim, eu sei que vou!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Ayooo, what’s up?! Nice to meet ya! I hope we can be
good friends!
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh, but, uh... You probably don’t wanna be around when
I’m hungry, yo.
<$comeff(1,19)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,3)>I kinda have this bad habit of gulping down everything in
sight and, like, dissolving it, so, y’know—
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,10)>*rumble gurgle* Uh-oh...
<$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,7)>Yo, can we have this conversation another time? My bad!
Really sorry about this!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Ayooo, o que está acontecendo?! Prazer em conhecê-lo! Espero que possamos ser
Bons amigos!
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,7)>Mas... provavelmente não quer estar por perto quando...
Estou com fome, meu.
<$comeff(1,19)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,3)>Tenho o mau hábito de engolir tudo em
visão e, como, dissolvendo-o, então, você sabe--
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,10)>Uh-oh...
<$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,7)>Podemos ter esta conversa noutra altura?
Peço imensa desculpa por isto!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Heyyy. This place sure is relaxing. Oooh, I think I just
drooled a little...
<$comeff(1,5)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,8)>Huh? You made this? That’s sooo nice. Thank you...
<$comeff(1,13)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Guess I’ll need to be careful so I don’t dissolve this nice
home with my drooool...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Este lugar é mesmo relaxante.
Babei um pouco...
<$comeff(1,5)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,8)>Você fez isso? Isso é tão legal. Obrigado...
<$comeff(1,13)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Acho que eu vou precisar ter cuidado para que eu não dissolver este agradável
em casa com o meu drooool...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,4)>Ow! Kicked again...
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,3)>I’d hoped I wouldn’t get kicked since I didn’t see any
humans around here...
<$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,8)>Wait a minute... You’re a Pokémon, aren’t you!
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,5)>I guess it’s still possible for me to be kicked by a Pokémon
who LOOKS like a human, huh...
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Well, I learned something today. Thanks.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,4)>Chutado outra vez...
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,3)>Eu esperava que eu não iria ser chutado, uma vez que eu não vi nenhum
Humanos por aqui...
<$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,8)>Espere um minuto... Você é um Pokémon, não é?
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,5)>Eu acho que ainda é possível para mim ser chutado por um Pokémon
que parece um humano, huh...
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Hoje aprendi uma coisa.

dialogues.en:
<$motion(1,17)><$comeff(1,9)><$voicel(1,8)><$facial(1,4)>Grom nom nom... So yummy! ♪
<$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)><$facial(1,1)>Oh—hi. Nice to meetcha.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,39)>The boulders here are really cold and crunchy. I could eat
a mountain of them. ♪
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,49)>Let me know if you find any more tasty-looking boulders!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$motion(1,17)><$comeff(1,9)><$voicel(1,8)><$facial(1,4)>Grom nom nom tão gostoso!
<$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)><$facial(1,1)>Prazer em conhecê-lo.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,39)>As pedras aqui são muito frias e crocantes.
Uma montanha deles.
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,49)>Avisa-me se encontrares mais pedras saborosas!

dialogues.en:
Three... <$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,14)>Two... <$motion(1,807)>One... <$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,5)>
... ... ...<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,6)>Hm?<$lookat(1,1,0)>
<$comeff(1,11)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,815)><$voicel(1,10)><$textsize(2)>AHHH!!!
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>Oh my goodness, who in the world are you?! It’s dangerous
to be here right now!
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,8)>I overslept so much that my mind is all groggy...
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,814)><$voicel(1,7)>I was JUST about to clear my head with a big explosion!
<$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,825)><$voicel(1,9)>Although, actually...I think the start you gave me may have
done the trick—I don’t feel sleepy at all anymore!
<$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,817)><$voicel(1,7)>So it all worked out after all. Thank you, dear!
dialogues.pt_br:
Três... <$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,14)>Dois... <$motion(1,807)>Uma... <$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,5)>
... ... ...<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,6)>Hm?<$lookat(1,1,0)>
<$comeff(1,11)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,815)><$voicel(1,10)><$textsize(2)>AHHH!!!
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>Oh meu Deus, quem no mundo é você?! É perigoso
Estar aqui agora mesmo!
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,8)>Dormi tanto que a minha mente está grogue...
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,814)><$voicel(1,7)>Eu estava prestes a clarear a cabeça com uma grande explosão!
<$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,825)><$voicel(1,9)>Embora, na verdade... eu acho que o começo que você me deu pode ter
feito o truque – Eu não sinto mais sonolento!
<$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,817)><$voicel(1,7)>Então, afinal, tudo correu bem.

dialogues.en:
... ... ...
... ... ...<$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,6)>Hm?
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)>Ummm. Do I...<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)>know you?
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)>Ohhh. Are we...friends? <$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)>Maybe?
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,802)>Ahhh. Maybe not?
<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,14)>Uhhh, well...<$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,5)>it’s nice to meet you. ♪
dialogues.pt_br:
... ... ...
... ... ...<$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,6)>Hm?
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)>Ummm. Se eu...<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)>Conhece-o?
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,14)>Ohhh. Estamos...Amigos? <$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)>Talvez?
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,802)>Talvez não?
<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,14)>Uhh, bem...<$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,5)>é um prazer conhecê-lo.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,10)>Oh, I just had a gooood idea!
<$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Heyyy. Hey yooouuu! Listen to my good idea.
<$comeff(1,13)>... ...<$facial(1,1)><$comeff(1,14)> ...
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,8)>Uhhh... What was it again?
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Ohhh well. Anyway, hope to see you around...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,10)>Tive uma ideia.
<$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Ouve a minha boa ideia.
<$comeff(1,13)>... ...<$facial(1,1)><$comeff(1,14)> ...
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,8)>O que foi mesmo?
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>De qualquer forma, espero ver-te por aí...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,5)>Fwahhh.<$lookat(1,1,0)>
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>Ah. It is a human. I must emit my friendship waves.
<$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,1)><$motionoff(1,817)><$voicel(1,7)>*beep beep* Hello. Hello. Konnichiwa. Merci. Xie xie.
Arigato ne. Thank you.
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,3)>Its reaction is not what I expected. What do I do.<$motion(0,182)>
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,9)>What? You are a Pokémon? <$comeff(1,13)><$motion(0,181)>Let us be friends.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,5)>Fwahhh.<$lookat(1,1,0)>
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>É um humano, tenho de emitir ondas de amizade.
<$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,1)><$motionoff(1,817)><$voicel(1,7)>Olá, Konnichiwa, Merci, Xie xie.
Obrigado.
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,3)>A sua reacção não é o que eu esperava.<$motion(0,182)>
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,9)>És um Pokémon? <$comeff(1,13)><$motion(0,181)>Sejamos amigos.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,814)><$voicel(1,5)>*bzzzt bzzzt* Greetings.
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,7)>I do look like just three Magnemite sticking together,
yes?
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>Well, we are just sticking together. Yes.
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,7)>Actually, it requires much skill to work together as three.
<$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>So I think we too can be good friends. We and you.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,814)><$voicel(1,5)>*bzzzt bzzzt* Saudações.
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,7)>Eu pareço apenas três Magnemite grudados,
não é?
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>Bem, nós estamos apenas grudados. Sim.
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,7)>Na verdade, requer muita habilidade trabalhar juntos em três.
<$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>Então acho que nós também podemos ser bons amigos. Nós e você.

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Huh? An intruder? In my territory?! Yooo! Are you after
my leek?!?!
<$comeff(1,22)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,9)>My faithful leek’s been with me for years! There’s NO WAY
I’ll hand it over without a fight! En garde ’n’ stuff, yo!
<$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>... ... ...
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)>Oh. You’re, uh...not here to steal my leek? <$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,8)>My bad, yo!
<$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,10)>Phew. Well, that’s a relief. But I’m feelin’ kinda hungry
after all that excitement...
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,6)>... ... ...
Yo, this leek’s lookin’ super tasty right now...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Um intruso no meu território?
Meu alho-poró?!!!
<$comeff(1,22)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,9)>Meu fiel alho-poró está comigo há anos! NÃO É VELHA
Eu vou entregá-lo sem lutar! En garde ’n’ coisas, yo!
<$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>... ... ...
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)>Não está aqui para roubar o meu alho-poró? <$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,8)>Foi mal, meu!
<$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,10)>Ufa. Bem, isso é um alívio. Mas eu estou sentindo ' meio fome
Depois de toda aquela excitação...
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,6)>... ... ...
Yo, este alho-porro está olhando’ super saboroso agora...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Wow, a human! Yaaay! ♪ I’m gonna follow it!<$motion(0,182)>
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,8)>Gah! Whaaat? You’re just a Pokémon.
<$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,3)>Aw, that’s too bad. If you were a human, I figured you’d
be carrying a ton of tasty trash...<$facial(1,1)><$motion(0,181)><$motion(0,824)><$motion(0,652)>
Huh?<$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,6)> You’re searching for humans too?
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,5)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Oh, neat! Well, if I can do anything to help, let me know.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Uau, um humano! Yaaay! ♪ Vou segui-lo!<$motion(0,182)>
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,8)>Gah! Whaaat? Você é apenas um Pokémon.
<$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,3)>Aw, isso é muito ruim. Se você fosse um humano, eu pensei que você
estar carregando uma tonelada de lixo saboroso...<$facial(1,1)><$motion(0,181)><$motion(0,824)><$motion(0,652)>
Huh?<$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,6)> Você também está procurando por humanos?
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,5)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>Bem, se eu puder fazer alguma coisa para ajudar, avise-me.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Oh heyyy. I have a question for you.
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Could you tell me the diiirtiest place around here?
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,5)>It used to be sooo much easier to find sludge and sewage
back in the day.
<$comeff(1,19)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,3)>But it looks like there’s wayyy less of it these days.
That’s a seeerious environmental issue, don’t you think?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Tenho uma pergunta para ti.
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Pode dizer-me qual é o lugar mais diirituoso por aqui?
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,5)>Costumava ser muito mais fácil encontrar lamas e esgotos
Há muito tempo.
<$comeff(1,19)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,3)>Mas parece que há muito menos hoje em dia.
Essa é uma questão ambiental seerious, você não acha?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Whoa, I bet living here would be a real gas. Plus, there’s
no way the wind can get to me!
<$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>It’s not that I’m scared or anything—I’m just not a fan of
strong gusts of wind <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,10)>since I always get blown away! Hehe!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Whoa, Eu aposto que viver aqui seria um gás real. Além disso, há
O vento não me pode atingir!
<$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>Não é que eu estou com medo ou qualquer coisa - Eu não sou apenas um fã de
fortes rajadas de vento <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,10)>Desde sempre que me surpreendem!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Hey there, nice to meet you. It’s so dark and quiet here...
I like it.
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,5)>Now all it needs is some unsuspecting humans to pass by
every once in a while.
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,805)>I like to sneak up and tap ’em on the shoulder, then watch
’em scream and scatter. <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,5)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,9)>It’s pretty fun.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Hey lá, prazer em conhecê-lo. É tão escuro e silencioso aqui...
Eu gosto.
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,5)>Agora tudo o que precisa é de alguns humanos insuspeitos para passar
De vez em quando.
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,805)>Gosto de me esgueirar e bater no ombro, então assistir
Eles gritam e se espalham. <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,5)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,9)>É muito divertido.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>Huh? This human’s got a weird shadow. <$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,3)>I can’t figure out
how to slip into it...<$facial(1,1)><$motion(0,182)>
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,10)>Whoa! You’re not a human?! <$motion(0,181)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,9)>That’s an awesome
transformation, bud!
<$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)>But man, I can’t find a single human around here. <$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,7)>Where
the heck did they all go?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>Este humano tem uma sombra estranha. <$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,3)>Eu não consigo entender
Como esgueirar-se nele...<$facial(1,1)><$motion(0,182)>
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,10)>Whoa! Você não é humano?! <$motion(0,181)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,9)>Isso é um incrível
Transformação, amigo!
<$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)>Mas, cara, não consigo encontrar um único humano por aqui. <$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,7)>Onde
Que raio é que eles foram?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,806)>Oh? You there... <$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,8)>You’re quite the digger, aren’t ya?
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,1)><$comeff(1,14)>You may not be the same type as me, but I bet you can dig
in the ground freely <$voicel(1,5)>and change the terrain as you like...
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>I know you have that potential, bud. I can see it in ya!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,806)>está aí... <$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,8)>Você é bem escavador, não é?
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,1)><$comeff(1,14)>pode não ser do mesmo tipo que eu, mas aposto que consegues cavar.
no solo livremente <$voicel(1,5)>e mudar o terreno como quiser...
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Eu sei que tem esse potencial, amigo.

dialogues.en:
<$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh, uh... N-nice to meet you. <$comeff(1,6)>You’re...not a human?
You’re a Pokémon? <$motion(0,40)><$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,8)>Oh, thank goodness!
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,5)>Y’see, when humans were around, they’d always come
poke me with stuff, thinking I was a Poké Ball...
<$comeff(1,19)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,3)>They’d end up getting zapped, and I always felt so bad
for them...
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>W-well, I hope you and I can be friends, anyway!
Bzzzzzzrt...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Prazer em conhecê-la. <$comeff(1,6)>Você... não é humano?
Você é um Pokémon? <$motion(0,40)><$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,8)>Graças a Deus!
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,5)>Sim, quando os humanos estavam por perto, eles sempre vinham
Me cutuca com coisas, pensando que eu era um Poké Ball...
<$comeff(1,19)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,3)>Eles acabariam sendo zapped, e eu sempre me senti tão mal
para eles...
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Bem, espero que tu e eu possamos ser amigos, de qualquer maneira!
Bzzzzzzrt...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>Yooo, what a great place!
<$voicel(1,7)>Huh?! You made this? <$facial(1,13)><$comeff(1,21)><$motionoff(1,804)>That’s so awesome! Respect, yo!
<$comeff(1,13)><$motion(1,816)><$voicel(1,9)>I’ll do my best to not explode while I live here!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>Que sítio fantástico!
<$voicel(1,7)>Foste tu que fizeste isto? <$facial(1,13)><$comeff(1,21)><$motionoff(1,804)>Isso é tão incrível! Respeito, yo!
<$comeff(1,13)><$motion(1,816)><$voicel(1,9)>Farei o meu melhor para não explodir enquanto viver aqui!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,10)>Huh? What’s your deal? ...Hang on a sec!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,10)>Huh? Qual é o seu negócio? ...Espere um segundo!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,10)>OK, folks: any thoughts on this funky-lookin’ rando?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,10)>OK, pessoal: alguma idéia sobre este funky-lookin’ rando?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,10)>I say we act cool and be nice. I mean, our visitor here
doesn’t seem like a bad egg.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,10)>Quero dizer, o nosso visitante aqui
não parece um ovo ruim.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,10)>Yup, I agree.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,10)>Sim, eu concordo.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,10)>Sounds good to meee!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,10)>Parece-me bem!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>All right, thanks for waiting! Let’s be friends!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>Tudo bem, obrigado por esperar! Vamos ser amigos!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Hey. Heyyyy. You there. Can you weigh in on something
for us reeeaaal quick?
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,3)>Sooo here’s the thing. I’m sleepy right now and would
love a nice naaap...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,1)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Olá, tu aí, pode pesar em alguma coisa?
Para nós, rápido?
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,3)>Sooo aqui é a coisa. Estou com sono agora e faria
Adoro um bom naaap...

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,8)>But I want to eat some berries...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,8)>Mas eu quero comer algumas bagas...

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>And I want to go for a waaalk...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>E eu quero ir para um waaalk...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Sooo uh... Can you think of some way we can take a nap
and eat and go on a walk all at the same tiiime?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Consegues pensar numa maneira de dormirmos uma sesta?
e comer e ir a um passeio tudo no mesmo tilme?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,8)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,899)><$comeff(1,5)>Ack! A human!
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,1)>Wait, maybe not? Are you...a Pokémon? Phew! OK, guess
I’m safe for now.
<$voicel(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)>This place looks nice ’n’ quiet, so I think I’ll stay around
here for a while! <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,38)>Let’s be friends, OK?
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,805)>... ... ...
Mom prob’ly woulda liked a place like this too...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,8)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,899)><$comeff(1,5)>Um humano!
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,1)>Espera, talvez não sejas Pokémon?
Estou seguro por enquanto.
<$voicel(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)>Este lugar parece agradável 'n' quieto, então eu acho que vou ficar por perto
Aqui por um tempo! <$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,38)>Vamos ser amigos, OK?
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,805)>... ... ...
Mamãe provavelmente gostaria de um lugar como este também...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, hello there. A pleasure to make your acquaintance.
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)>May I ask why you’re shaped like a human?<$motion(0,824)><$motion(0,652)>
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,14)>Ah, so you’re searching for humans, are you?
Fascinating.
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,20)>If there’s any way I can be of assistance, I’d be happy
to help.
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Being unable to meet your loved ones must be terribly
sad, after all.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,6)><$emotion(1,14)>Olá, é um prazer conhecê-lo.
<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)>Posso perguntar por que você tem a forma de um humano?<$motion(0,824)><$motion(0,652)>
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,14)>Ah, então você está procurando por humanos, não é?
Fascinante.
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,806)><$comeff(1,20)>Se houver alguma maneira de eu poder ser de ajuda, eu ficaria feliz
Para ajudar.
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Ser incapaz de encontrar os seus entes queridos deve ser terrível.
triste, afinal de contas.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,814)><$voicel(1,9)><$textsize(2)>HIYAHHH!<$comeff(0,5)><$motion(0,132)>
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>Oh! You all right there? Sure am sorry if I startled ya!
<$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>I’m always practicin’ my kicks every chance I get—<$comeff(1,13)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,8)>watch
yerself when walkin’ through this area!
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,815)><$voicel(1,9)>Low kick! Hiyah! <$motion(1,814)><$comeff(1,10)>Mid kick! Hiyah!
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,10)>And a high kick! Hiyah!
<$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,817)><$voicel(1,7)>Yes, indeed! My kicks are snappy again today! Hahahaaa!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,814)><$voicel(1,9)><$textsize(2)>Olá!<$comeff(0,5)><$motion(0,132)>
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>Desculpa se te assustei!
<$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Eu estou sempre praticando’ meus chutes cada chance que eu tenho-<$comeff(1,13)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,8)>observar
você mesmo quando andando’ por esta área!
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,815)><$voicel(1,9)>Chute baixo! <$motion(1,814)><$comeff(1,10)>Um pontapé médio!
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,10)>E um pontapé alto!
<$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,817)><$voicel(1,7)>Sim, de fato, os meus pontapés estão mais rápidos hoje!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,814)>Hup... Hyah!<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,815)>
<$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>Oh, hey. Wanna join me for some training?
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,5)>Actually, hold up—it’s just about time for a break.
<$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Taking small, frequent breaks is the key to not wearing
yourself out. We can train later, OK?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,814)>Hup-hyah!<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,815)>
<$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>quer vir treinar comigo?
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,5)>Na verdade, espere - é apenas sobre a hora de uma pausa.
<$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Fazer pausas pequenas e frequentes é a chave para não usar
Podemos treinar mais tarde, está bem?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Oh, hi! Nice to meet you. This place is pretty great, huh?
It’s like a treasure trove...of trash! ♪
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,815)><$voicel(1,9)>It smells sooo good. I keep taking lots of deep breaths.
<$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>In...out...
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>In...out...
<$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,3)>Uh-oh. I think I’m gonna explode. <$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,816)>Bwhhh!
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,815)><$voicel(1,5)>Phew, that was close. I released some gas, so it’s fine now.
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,817)><$voicel(1,7)>Um, sorry if it was kinda stinky...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Prazer em conhecer-te, este lugar é fantástico.
É como um tesouro...De lixo!
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,815)><$voicel(1,9)>Cheira tão bem, continuo a respirar fundo.
<$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Em...Fora...
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Em...Fora...
<$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,3)>Acho que vou explodir. <$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,816)>Bwhhh!
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,815)><$voicel(1,5)>Ufa, isso foi perto. Eu liberei um pouco de gás, então está tudo bem agora.
<$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,817)><$voicel(1,7)>Desculpa se foi um bocado fedorento...

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Whoooaaa, a human... I was just wondering where all the
humans went.<$motion(0,824)><$motion(0,652)>
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,805)>What? You’re nooot a human? They’ve all gone off
somewhere?
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,46)>Oh, OK... That makes me kind of saaad...
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,6)>Places with lots of humans had tons of that niiice blaaack
smoke I love...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Whoooaaa, um humano... estava a pensar onde é que todos os
Os humanos foram-se.<$motion(0,824)><$motion(0,652)>
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,805)>O quê? Você não é um humano? Todos eles foram
Em algum lugar?
<$voicel(1,3)><$emotion(1,46)>Está bem, isso faz-me um pouco saaad...
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,6)>Lugares com muitos humanos tinham toneladas daquele niiice blaaack
Fumaça eu amo...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,8)>Oh! Hiya there! Nice to meet you! Umm, so! Gonna need
you to sit still for just a sec.
<$motion(1,802)>...<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>OK, got it! <$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,10)>You’re a good egg, right?
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>I’m pretty confident in my ability to judge someone’s
character based on their vibes!
<$comeff(1,13)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,9)>Let’s be friends, OK?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,8)>Olá, prazer em conhecer-te.
Fica quieto por um segundo.
<$motion(1,802)>...<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Está bem, já percebi! <$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,10)>Você é um bom ovo, certo?
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Estou muito confiante na minha capacidade de julgar alguém
personagem baseado em suas vibrações!
<$comeff(1,13)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,9)>Vamos ser amigos, OK?

dialogues.en:
<$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>Oooh, this place is so nice and warm! I’m gonna live here!
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>You can come here too—anytime you wanna take a nap!
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,9)>Oh, but I gotta warn you that I move my vines a lot in my
sleep. Sorry if you get tangled up in them!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,10)>Oooh, este lugar é tão agradável e quente! Eu vou viver aqui!
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>pode vir aqui também, sempre que quiseres dormir!
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,9)>Mas tenho de te avisar que movo muito as minhas vinhas.
Desculpa se te emaranhas com eles!

dialogues.en:
<$motion(1,816)><$comeff(1,10)>... ... ...
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,14)>Wait... Can you...
<$comeff(1,6)><$voicel(1,5)>Can you see this wall, yo? <$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,10)>You’re the real deal, huh?
<$comeff(1,13)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>That proves your heart’s, like, pure, y’know? I hope we
can be friends.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$motion(1,816)><$comeff(1,10)>... ... ...
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,14)>Espera, pode...
<$comeff(1,6)><$voicel(1,5)>Consegues ver esta parede? <$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,21)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,10)>Você é o verdadeiro negócio, hein?
<$comeff(1,13)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Isso prova que seu coração é puro, sabe?
podem ser amigos.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,814)><$voicel(1,9)>Swish!
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>Huh? What’s up? You need somethin’ from me?<$lookat(1,0,1)>
<$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,6)>Sorry, but it’ll have to wait. I gotta get my hundred
swings in!
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,815)><$voicel(1,9)>Swoosh... <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,807)>Uh... What number was that?
<$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Ah well, whatever. Time for a little break!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,814)><$voicel(1,9)>Swish!
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>Huh? O que há? Você precisa de algo de mim?<$lookat(1,0,1)>
<$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,6)>Desculpe, mas vai ter que esperar. Eu tenho que pegar meus cem
Acelere!
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,815)><$voicel(1,9)>Swoosh... <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,807)>Que número era esse?
<$comeff(1,1)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Está na hora de uma pausa.

dialogues.en:
